stem: In 1846 the United States and Great Britain negotiated the boundary of the disputed territory shown in this map. Which factor made the negotiations more challenging?

options.label: A
options.text: Supporters of Manifest Destiny argued for “Fifty-four forty or fight.”

options.label: B
options.text: The American Indians in the territory were hostile to settlers.

options.label: C
options.text: President James Polk opposed westward expansion to the Pacific Ocean.

options.label: D
options.text: Hazards along the Oregon Trail limited American settlement of the Northwest.

visual_elements: Map titled Oregon Country showing lines of 54°40', 49°, and 1819 with key for British territory, Disputed territory, U.S. territory, Mexican territory
